{"sourceType":"Non ESA Tender Action","sourceSystem":"ESA esa-star Publication","sourcePage":"https://esastar-publication-ext.sso.esa.int/nonEsaTenderActions/filter/open","id":1307,"idEra":1031,"activityNumber":"","contractNumber":"4000116500","tanumber":"17.DSFR.007","title":"BIOMASS Instrument SCOE","description":"The BIOMASS programme was selected as the 7th Earth Explorer mission in
Spring 2013 at the User Consultation Meeting in Graz, Austria. The overall
objective of the mission is to reduce the uncertainty in the worldwide
spatial distribution and dynamics of forest biomass in order to improve
current assessments and future projections of the global carbon cycle.

The objective will be achieved by implementation of a P-band SAR mission,
providing global maps of forest biomass stocks, forest disturbance and
growth.

This notification of Intended Invitation To Tender concerns the procurement
of the Instrument Electronic System (INES) Satellite Checkout Equipment 
(SCOE) by Airbus Defence and Space GmbH as a Core team 
member of the Biomass project. The supplier selection will be made in 
accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.

The Instrument Electronics System (INES) comprises the following subsystems:
- Central Electronics Subsystem (CES) including a Digital Control Unit (DCU), 
 Calibration Distribution Network (CDN), 
 all supported by an Application Software (ASW)
- Power Amplifier Subsystem (PAS)
- Receive Amplifier Subsystem (RAS)

The Feed Array is part of the BIOMASS Antenna System and has the function 
of transmitting and receiving the RF signals to and from the LDR (Large 
Deployable Reflector) by the INES. The LDR is an element of the Platform 
and forms together with the Instrument the SAR Payload.

The primary function of the INES SCOE is to provide the Biomass satellite
platform interfaces to the Instrument before it is integrated onto the 
platform. Hence, the INES SCOE shall provide the same interface types, 
interface connectors and functionalities than the ones provided by the 
platform, allowing interface verification and functional testing on Biomass
